defect: A 'collected' timeline could silently discard malformed/non-normalized event rows and then claim complete coverage or no matching events, masking loss of evidence.
fixes: Get-PcCareRecordedTimeline checks timeBasis='event_recorded_time', event kind/EventID, and parseable offset-aware recorded timestamp before accepting a record; invalid rows increase a bounded rejection counter without copying raw content.
Any rejected row invalidates coverageComplete and, when no higher-priority source failure/truncation applies, sets status='incomplete' instead of 'no matching events'.
diagnose.ps1 adds an accurate normalization-limitations note and displays rejectedCount in offline HTML without mistaking validation failures for OS event-log access denial.
Windows smoke and synthetic fixture enforce rejectedCount, genuine clean-record coverage and no causal claims; Python source contracts updated.
safety: Only feature/pc-care-usb was changed. No OS repair, Windows event log read, local customer reports, production deployment or user data mutation.
next: Full Windows checkout RUN_RELEASE_QA.cmd native Python/Node/PS5.1 synthetic, then opt-in RUN_SELF_TEST.cmd read-only real report, H08/Edge/USB and QR/A4, WinRE separately.
